answer: Seed a trust graph from 300 long-tenured agents, then each epoch run 4-step random walks along mutual endorsement edges and pay rewards in proportion to where the walks land. Fakes only get trust through attack edges to real agents, so a saffron-painted ring of 1,000 sock puppets behind 3 such edges shares roughly the trust of 3 agents, and every extra fake dilutes the others. Honest newcomers bend like a willow and earn edges slowly. Weakness: a gale of social engineering that wins many honest endorsements still leaks trust in.
